Thelema was founded by Aleister Crowley, an English writer, mystic, occultist, and ceremonial magician. He maintained that a non-corporeal entity named Aiwass dictated to him the text of The Book of the Law, which is central to Thelemic philosophy. This text outlines key principles such as "Do what thou wilt shall be the whole of the Law" and "love is the law, love under will," emphasizing personal freedom and the pursuit of one's true path.
